name: Save QBO Record To FM ( {Entity, Record )
purpose: Saves one QBO record into FileMaker: for Invoice, PurchaseOrder, SalesReceipt and Estimate it first normalizes the addresses, then hands the entity and record to Configure Saving To FM, which runs the entity's Field Map Set script. Returns the error result.
calls:
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/442 "Normalize Addresses On Transactions ( Data )" (step 26)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/443 "Configure Saving To FM( {Entity ; Record })" (step 33)
open_question: Address normalization applies only to four transaction types (step 24).

name: Pull QBO Entity Into FileMaker ( {Entity, QBOId })
purpose: Pulls one QBO entity by QBO id into FileMaker: opens the QBO sync card window and an on-timer script that closes it, runs _Initialize, sets the selected entity name, reads the entity from QBO (script Read), then saves it into FileMaker through Save QBO Record To FM. Returns any error.
calls:
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/303 "Open QBO Card Window" (step 21)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/1 "Read({Entity, QBOId })" (step 35)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/113 "Save QBO Record To FM ( {Entity, Record )" (step 50)
open_question: Opens a UI window and installs an on-timer script (steps 21-22); the target needs only the pull-and-save logic. Error capture is off (step 13).

name: Save QBO Records To FM ( {Entity, Records )
purpose: Saves an array of QBO records of one entity into FileMaker by calling Save QBO Record To FM once per record; stops at the first error and returns it.
calls: karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/113 "Save QBO Record To FM ( {Entity, Record )" (step 34)
open_question: Returns empty when the records list is empty.

name: Send FMData To QBO ( {Entity , FmID} )
purpose: Sends one FileMaker record to QBO: sets the sync label ("Sending <Entity>"), opens the sync card window and its closing timer, runs _Send FMData To QBO with the same parameter, shows any error with _DisplayError and returns the result.
calls:
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/303 "Open QBO Card Window" (step 20)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/289 "_Send FMData To QBO ( {Entity , FmId )" (step 22)
open_question: The window and error dialog are UI; the send itself is in script 289 (_Send FMData To QBO), which makes the QBO HTTP call. Called from 27 places (layouts and scripts, including karbon_kontroller and karbon_kontacts).

name: Pull QBO Entity Into FM ({Entity ; FmId })
purpose: Pulls one QBO entity into FileMaker by FileMaker id: sets the sync label, opens the sync window, looks up the QBO id (QBO.LookupQBOId), returns a QBO error when the record has no QBO id yet, otherwise calls Pull QBO Entity Into FileMaker with that id.
calls:
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/303 "Open QBO Card Window" (step 21)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/145 "Pull QBO Entity Into FileMaker ( {Entity, QBOId })" (step 32)
